recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It fixes the only active stale Location.telecom narrative reference found, without disturbing the deliberate R5 model where contact details moved to Location.contact and physical address remains Location.address.
issue_request: FHIR-25375 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested role-specific, time-bounded contact details on Location and was ultimately resolved by adding Location.contact 0..* ExtendedContactDetail, replacing Location.telecom, and relying on the FHIR-29035 datatype.
initial_application: Historical commits had already added Location.contact as ExtendedContactDetail, later kept Location.address as the physical address, and removed Location.telecom while updating Location examples. The remaining active gap was a Location narrative note that still listed Location.telecom.
additional_context: FHIR-29035 created ExtendedContactDetail with purpose, name, telecom, address, organization, and period; PA 2021-12-01 minutes record reopening FHIR-25375 to use that datatype. source/fhir.ini lists Location as an active resource, while the other stale Location.telecom path found in the CDA profile is commented out of the build.
reconciliation: Changed source/location/location-notes.xml to list Location.contact among Location elements relevant for instance-mode locations. No structural source changes were needed because source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml already defines Location.contact 0..* ExtendedContactDetail, omits Location.telecom, and intentionally retains physical Location.address.
source_changes: source/location/location-notes.xml: replaced the stale Location.telecom list item with Location.contact in the instance-mode Location guidance.

related_jiras.note: Created the ExtendedContactDetail datatype used by the final FHIR-25375 resolution.
